question: Which Indian actress was honoured at Cannes 2025 as part of the 'Women in Cinema' initiative?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jacqueline Fernandez**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Jacqueline Fernandez, a prominent Indian actress, was honoured at the Cannes Film Festival 2025 under the 'Women in Cinema' initiative.
 
• This initiative is aimed at celebrating and recognizing the significant contributions of women in the global film industry.
 
• Jacqueline Fernandez is known for her extensive work in Bollywood as well as her active participation in philanthropic and social causes, which added to her recognition.
 
• She has been an advocate for women empowerment and has used her influence to address issues related to gender equality in the film industry.
 
• This accolade reflects her contribution to cinema and her efforts to inspire and pave the way for women in the entertainment sector worldwide.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Deepika Padukone**

 
 
• Deepika Padukone is a celebrated Indian actress and producer known for her impactful performances in films like "Padmaavat" and "Chennai Express."
 
• She has represented India at several international platforms, including being a jury member at the Cannes Film Festival 2022.
 
• Deepika is also an advocate for mental health awareness and the founder of the Live Love Laugh Foundation, focusing on mental health issues.
 
 
 
• **Priyanka Chopra**
 
 
• Priyanka Chopra is an internationally acclaimed actress, producer, and former Miss World 2000.
 
• She has worked in both Bollywood and Hollywood, starring in films like "The White Tiger" and "Baywatch."
 
• Priyanka is also a UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador and has been actively involved in humanitarian causes, including child rights and education.
 
 
 
• **Alia Bhatt**
 
 
• Alia Bhatt is an award-winning Indian actress known for her versatile performances in films such as "Raazi" and "Gangubai Kathiawadi."
 
• She made her debut at the Met Gala 2023, representing Indian fashion and culture on an international platform.
 
• Alia has also ventured into production with her banner Eternal Sunshine Productions.
